verdict.rationale: Open tracking is a fair question for an email-sending API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions open tracking, read receipts or open timestamps. The webhook and WebSocket docs describe event delivery only in general terms (e.g., new email), and labels are user-applied tags, not recipient-open signals. Neither counts as this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
